entries.grant: Exactly 1 after transport quiescence and no pending writes; store must also have no unACK records.
entries.zero: Resume transport and cancel maintenance before the durable stop barrier.
entries.negative_or_above_one: Terminate actor with existing actor_error=-100; no maintenance report, erase or new session.
entries.change: R2 now rejects positive values greater than 1. Negative fatal and zero race behavior preserved.

entries.grant: Exactly 1, full log with no pending replay records.
entries.other: Existing actor_error=-104; no erase and no resume of the already stopped session.
entries.change: None. Original and candidate tests confirm this entry was already strict.

entries.grant: Only replay-only or sleep-prepared mode; pressure=1, IRQ=1, pending=0, quiet=1; healthy store and no contact fault.
entries.other: Negative pending/quiet is fault; other nonmatching gates defer; unACK data remains rejected by storage.
entries.change: None. Original and candidate signed-boundary tests verify the existing exact-domain checks.

entries.grant: safe_idle exactly 1; recording/offering/fault clear; all required callbacks available; every committed record ACKed.
entries.other: Return -3 before changing durable intent or bytes when safe_idle is not 1.
entries.change: R2 replaces truthiness with exact 1. Original negative reproduction uses a fully ACKed fixture.

entries.grant: get_erase_intent succeeds and returns exactly 1: resume previously authorized erase and clear intent.
entries.invalid: Return -1, stop recording and leave log faulted; retain all media and intent unchanged.
entries.change: R2 enforces 0/1 at generic adapter boundary. It does not require a new idle grant for a valid previously persisted erase intent.

entries.grant: Existing NVS get_intent already rejects values above 1 before generic pen_store_open recovery.
entries.change: None. Host API-double test verifies intent=0, intent=1 and all 2..255; this is not an ESP-IDF target build or actual NVS test.

integer_probe_scope: Each signed gate tested over -255..255 plus INT_MIN, INT_MAX, -65536 and 65536. This is not exhaustive over all representable int values.
limitations: These tests do not prove real IRQ/capture hold atomicity, physical Flash persistence, hardware sleep or race freedom.
